title: Microsoft's market value overtakes Apple's to close out week
text: Microsoft's market value overtakes Apple's to close out week Friday, 30 November 2018 ( 25 minutes ago ) Microsoft Corp's stock market value closed above Apple Inc's for the first time in eight years on Friday as the Windows maker benefited from growth in cloud computing while Apple was hit by investor concern about iPhone demand. ▶ Apple Having Worst Month In Years 00:47 Business Insider reports that Apple stock is on pace to have its worst month since 2008. The stock has dropped 21% and wiping out over $200 billion in value. Apple lost its crown as the most valuable U.S. company to Microsoft this week.
